title: Media Intent Taxonomy
description: Describes the intended editorial function of visual media on timeline, without referencing filenames or technical assets.

values.description: Deliver persuasive, empathetic, or authoritative human connection.
First impactful view of the primary living space or property highlight.
Sequential proof and comprehension of layout, rooms, and metrics.
Immersive appreciation of a key differentiator (e.g. gourmet balcony).
Focused visual proof of architectural or finish details.
Help viewer mentally map room flow and real-world proportions.
Establish macro-surroundings and general urban setting.
Provide verified evidence of proximity to specified POIs / highways.
Substantiate common building facilities and leisure infrastructure.
Evoke the emotional experience of living in the property.
Visually assist cognitive digestion of pricing, down payment, and installment terms.
Guide viewer attention to conversion mechanism and next steps.
Provide mood, light, and aesthetic texture without specific metric claim.
Maintain visual cohesion during verbal bridges and pauses.
